items.title: Technical Deep Dive: AgentCore Payments and Innovation in Agentic Commerce
items.summary: Amazon's Bedrock AgentCore Payments is available in preview, enabling instant payments to external services without manual billing setup. This innovation is set to redefine financial interactions within multi-agent systems, empowering developers with seamless financial integration capabilities.
